evidence_snippets: How the Navigation SDK works You can integrate the Navigation SDK into your app with or without an existing Maps SDK implementation.
If your app uses the Maps SDK for its map layer, you can add the Navigation SDK to your app to enable the navigation experience.
You cannot use the Navigation SDK without also having the Maps SDK installed in your app.
